test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per Census 2011, which of the following states has the lowest child sex ratio?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **Census 2011**, the state of **Haryana** recorded the lowest **child sex ratio**, which is the number of females per 1000 males in the age group of 0-6 years.
 
• The child sex ratio in Haryana stood at an alarming figure of **834 females per 1000 males**.
 
• The low child sex ratio in Haryana is primarily attributed to **gender-based discrimination** and the practice of **female foeticide**, which has been prevalent in the region despite government efforts to curb it.
 
• The **child sex ratio** is a critical indicator of the **status of women and gender equality** in society.
 
• Various schemes and campaigns like **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao** have been introduced by the government to address this issue in Haryana.
 
• Haryana's government has taken steps to promote **gender equality** through awareness programs and stricter enforcement of laws against **prenatal sex determination**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Punjab**__

 __
 
• **Punjab** also has a low child sex ratio as per Census 2011, but it is slightly better than Haryana, recorded at **846 females per 1000 males**.
 
• Punjab faces similar challenges related to **female foeticide** and gender discrimination.
 
• The state has implemented various initiatives to tackle these issues, including promoting **education for girls** and strict enforcement of laws.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**__
 __
 
• Rajasthan's child sex ratio is comparatively higher than Haryana and Punjab, recorded at **888 females per 1000 males**.
 
• While Rajasthan has challenges related to gender inequality, it has made efforts to improve the condition through schemes like **Rajshree Yojana**, which incentivizes families for educating girl children.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**__
 
 
• Madhya Pradesh recorded a child sex ratio of **918 females per 1000 males**, showing relatively better gender balance compared to Haryana, Punjab, and Rajasthan.
 
• The state has focused on initiatives like **Ladli Laxmi Yojana** to improve the status of girls and reduce gender-based discrimination.
